title: release-rollout-canary-notes
content:
Personal scratchpad: Canary rollout for runtime v2.7.3

Objective:
- Deploy inference-runtime v2.7.3 with attention optimization and kv-cache fix to 5% of traffic initially. Validate latency and error rate vs v2.7.2 baseline.

Rollout high-level
- Canary cohort: route 5% of production traffic (traffic split by route key), pick low-risk routes (internal-team, beta customers)
- Duration: 24h minimum with stable metrics; extend to 72h for putative regression
- Environments: dedicated-prod (N. Virginia) first, then cross-region if stable

Version pinning & build
- Pin model-serving image tag: inference-runtime:2.7.3-20260219
- Config changes: set DEFAULT_KV_CACHE=true; batch_size=32 (see runtime-config PR)
- Verify image digest in registry: sha256:abc123... (TODO: replace with real digest)

Pre-rollout checks (TODO checklist)
- [ ] GC/rollback runbook updated (linked to runbook page)
- [ ] SLO/alert thresholds confirmed with SRE
- [ ] Canary dashboard created (latency p50/p95, error rate, 5xx count, token cost)
- [ ] Smoke tests pass on staging and pre-prod
- [ ] Dependency matrix: beam/comp kernels compatibility confirmed

Monitoring & success criteria
- Latency: p95 change <= +10% relative to baseline
- Error rate: 5xx increase <= +0.1 percentage points absolute
- Cost per token: no regressions > +5%
- Model output quality: run 500 prompt eval set, semantic pass rate >= 98%

Rollback triggers (immediate)
- Spike in 5xx >= 2x baseline sustained for 10m
- p95 latency increase > +20% for 15m
- Output quality drop > 3% on eval set or critical customer report

Rollout steps (detailed)
1) Build and push image, note digest
2) Deploy to canary pool (k8s canary service annotation: redwood/canary=true)
3) Route 5% traffic via traffic-split service (feature-flag/traffic-controller)
4) Run smoke tests against canary endpoints (./scripts/smoke-canary.sh)
5) Monitor dashboards: check latency, errors, resource (GPU mem) usage
6) If stable after 24h, increase to 25% for 12h, then 50% for 6h, then 100% rollout
7) Communicate status in #releases and @sre + @product

Notes to self / open questions
- Need confirmation from infra on host kernel patch that landed last week — could affect perf (ask Samir)
- Should we enable experimental quantization toggle for 10% of canary? Risky, prefer separate A/B
- Add synthetic load to exercise long-seq paths during canary window

Post-rollout
- Snapshot metrics and upload to confluence (page above)
- Postmortem if rollback triggered
- Update changelog and release notes (templates in GH)

Quick links
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RELEASE/2026-Q1-Canary-Plan
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-runtime/pull/452
- Jira: JIRA-1234

Small personal TODOs
- Ping Priya for traffic-split config
- Confirm image digest and replace placeholder
- Add canary dashboard tile for 'kv-cache hit rate'

End of scratchpad (work-in-progress, rough)
